name: Botany
boundaries: Botany: fundamental discoveries and enabling technologies within this field. Include cross-field consequences where the central advance belongs to this field; exclude routine incremental optimization. Use the historical breakthroughs in the prompt to calibrate revolutionary impact.

original_dispositions.reason: Added with causal uncertainty and speculative applications separated from evolutionary explanation.
The relationship between local cell-to-cell channels and long-distance routes remains an empirical question.
Neither a Nod-factor-independent route nor a particular nodule program is assumed necessary.
Covered as a hypothesis to test, not asserted as an established or uniquely necessary mechanism. It does not warrant a separate entry alongside the broader causal mechanism.

Added at the transferable-capability level. The proposed universal switch is unverified, and perennial rice is already demonstrated.

Comparative trap evolution is a worthwhile question, but the evidence reviewed does not establish that a universal transferable program exists or that this specific capability clears the selected revolutionary-impact threshold. The proposed pesticide-free crop and industrial benefits require additional demonstrations. A review of convergent carnivory and its diversity is available at https://www.butbn.cas.cz/adamec/Ann_Bot21_review.pdf, introduction and review sections.

reconciliation_change_log.reason: Each is framed as a general principle or capability rather than the mere existence of an unsolved problem.

The original list’s numerical fertilizer, emissions and nutrient-efficiency claims, universal switches, and immediate downstream applications are not adopted without evidence. In particular, perennial rice already exists.
BOT-13 and BOT-17 share mechanical inputs but address distinct capabilities; BOT-01 and BOT-16 both involve symbiotic signaling but concern different microbial partnerships and outputs.
